state: The design under review is a source language rather than an implemented runtime. Isolated one-call tables already support initial model-field paths, simultaneous overrides and untouched-state evaluation with fixture dependency closure. Its canonical delivery recipe contains normalized request inputs and initial status/result/error only; the test framework derives owner, target binding, principal, protected ID and version. Valid transport shapes are pending with null payloads, succeeded with its declared result and no error, failed with no result and a closed safe error, unknown with no result and optional safe diagnostic, and skipped with neither. Successful files additionally obey existing receiving app/owner and canonical operation-delivery-result-field finalization provenance and attachment limits; arbitrary identifiers, structural file values and unrelated uploads remain invalid. Receipt attributes are currently not selector-writable, so unchanged requests appear in five or six snapshots differing only in initial outcomes. Preserve independent expected values and setup failure for inconsistent envelopes; do not dispatch a network effect or mutate production receipts. The authoring solution may revise draft contracts but must not add general inheritance, constructors or test-write actions. There is no private source or real tenant material in this brief.

fixture_contract.instructions: Which route best balances full state coverage, fixed delivery authority, valid file provenance, minimal repeated source and precise initial setup semantics? Treat preference as advice rather than proof.

criteria.separate_recipes: Use the established complete recipe kind repeatedly for each initial outcome, leaving selector behavior alone. Validation and ordering stay simple and explicit; identical request payloads and recipe declarations continue to recur.
criteria.initial_selectors: Recognize direct recipe-root paths for initial status/result/error only in ordinary isolated rows. Resolve cells against an immutable baseline planning context, prohibit overlapping aliases and protected paths, apply the selected attributes as one envelope, and run existing normalized-request/result/error/provenance checks before publishing the single receipt for that row. Production association members and sequence-time edits stay read-only; binding, request, principal, owner and identity cannot be changed. Concision improves with a new clearly bounded setup planning phase.
criteria.factor_existing_fields: Without modifying delivery selectors, retain full per-outcome recipes whose request arguments reference existing frozen domain fields or named text messages. It shares data already present and preserves established recipe rules, but still repeats outcome recipe layouts, can introduce association dependency cycles and lacks a general typed request-value recipe.
